highlights.title: Overview
highlights.value: HIM Business School, formerly known as Hotel Institute Montreux (HIM), has been launching students into careers in hospitality since 1984. You'll see students from over 100 countries at HIM, which is situated in the strikingly beautiful town of Montreux on Lake Geneva. HIM Switzerland is famous for its Bachelor of Business Administration (BBA) in Hospitality Management, accredited by Northwood University (USA). With a lot of extracurricular activities such as sports clubs and cultural events, Hotel Institute Montreux focuses on nurturing its students in all aspects, alongside academic success.

highlights.title: Student life
highlights.value: With students from over 100 countries, you can imagine how dynamic and multicultural life at HIM will be! At the Hotel Institute Montreux, you'll always enjoy the lovely lakeside views, which consistently help you unwind. Besides, there are sports clubs for football, basketball and volleyball, along with quite a lot of extracurricular activities. As an international student, you will surely have a well-rounded experience here.

highlights.title: Accommodation
highlights.value:
As an international student, you'll find your stay at Hotel Institute Montreux comfortable and convenient. They provide both single and shared rooms, and all the rooms have modern amenities. The best part is, most rooms offer a beautiful view of the scenic Lake Geneva. Other facilities include a fitness centre, Starbucks self-service, storage, laundry room, and dry cleaning service. Overall, the accommodation at HIM will be relaxing and inspiring for you.

If you’re looking for budget-friendly accommodation options outside the campus, download our app and check out the Stays feature!

highlights.title: Facilities
highlights.value:
Library

The library at HIM has a vast collection of both physical books and digital materials, and the school has maintained it as a quiet space for you to focus and immerse yourself in your preferred study topics. The resources available at the library will be more than enough for all your academic and research needs.

Sports

At HIM, the regular physical training sessions and external competitions will become an everyday component of your life. You can join clubs for football, basketball, volleyball, badminton, and others on the campus. The school is focused on inspiring its students to improve their physical fitness and overall health. Also, these sports activities will give you opportunities to meet like-minded people outside of the school.

Laboratory

You'll have all you need to ace your skills in hospitality services at the state-of-the-art labs of HIM. These labs will help you gain practical experience and help you understand how to combine classroom theory with real-world applications.

Cafeteria

The cafeterias at HIM Business School may be the best spot for you to relax and socialise with your peers from various parts of the world. The cafeteria focuses on catering to a wide range of tastes and diets, while making sure the food served is fresh, balanced, and diverse.
